systems.system: Population Database of the Civil Status Administrative Census (RAVEC)/NINA Card
systems.tiers: national; listed as Mali's foundational ID system, with no digital ID (names verified early 2024, Findex fieldwork 18 July to 13 October 2024)

note: A global identity coverage dataset: for Mali it names only the foundational ID system and adult ID ownership, and says nothing of how civil status centres register births or deaths. The Annex E coverage table is misaligned in the text layer, so no Mali figure is taken from it.
